rationale: THE MISSING-NAME RECOVERY (2026-11-18). `accessor: number` is a valid class field NAMED `accessor`; the pinned tree-sitter grammar mis-reads it as the auto-accessor keyword and emits `public_field_definition name: (MISSING property_identifier)`, whose `.text` is empty. The analyzer used to publish a symbol named "" and a `contains Config -> ""` edge — the ONE no-target edge the whole-population arm flagged as a LANE DEFECT (992,652 edges, 1 empty target; located by a parallel whole-corpus scan at redwood/packages/jobs/src/adapters/PrismaAdapter/PrismaAdapter.ts:75). The fix recovers the written name from the node's own leading identifier and refuses an empty identity outright. The second field, `other`, is the CONTROL: a name the grammar carries normally must be untouched by the recovery. The count pin makes the recovery's scope checkable: exactly two contains rows for Config, and no empty-named symbol can exist because the analyzer filters any it would otherwise leave.

expectRelationships.note: THE GAIN: the recovered name is the member symbol and the containment target — not ""
CONTROL: the normally-parsed field is untouched

expectRelationshipCount.note: exactly the two fields — a recovery that manufactured extra members would fail here

forbidRelationships.note: THE DEFECT: no containment edge may name nothing
